Question: The sum \[\dfrac{1}{2!}+\dfrac{2}{3!}+\dfrac{3}{4!}+\cdots+\dfrac{2021}{2022!}\] can be expressed as \(a-\dfrac{1}{b!},\) where \(a\) and \(b\) are positive integers. What is \(a+b?\)
